name: kiasumiles
description: Hosted Singapore credit-card miles optimizer for Codex via MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex which Singapore miles card to use at a merchant.
interface.longDescription: KiasuMiles bundles a hosted MCP server and agent guidance for Singapore credit-card miles recommendations. It keeps merchant lookup and card ranking on the live KiasuMiles service while wallet data stays client-side.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KiasuMiles to help me choose the best card for a Singapore merchant.
